title.en: Blizzard Clarifies Horde Having Access to Dalaran Not Really Intended
title.es: Blizzard aclara que el acceso de la horda a Dalaran no es realmente intencionado

summary.en: Blizzard Clarifies Horde Having Access to Dalaran Not Really Intended...
summary.es: Blizzard aclara que la horda tiene acceso a Dalaran no es realmente la intención...

contentHtml:
Josh Greenfield has clarified on X (Twitter) that Horde having full access to Dalaran isn't intended and will be looked at.

Earlier today, players discovered that Horde gets access to Dalaran City after completing the City of Dalaran dungeon and the related quests. He has now posted on social media that Horde having full access to Dalaran isn't really intended and they'll be looking at it.

Tweet #2108378470598455556


In addition, Horde getting Kirin Tor reputation is already fixed internally but not until next week.

Tweet #2108379795902156951

title.en: Wolfshead Helm Nerfed in Latest WoW: Forever Beta Build
title.es: Wolfshead Helm Nerfed en la última versión de WoW: Forever Beta

summary.en: Wolfshead Helm Nerfed in Latest WoW: Forever Beta Build...
summary.es: Wolfshead Helm Nerfed en el último WoW: Forever Beta Build...

contentHtml:
The popular Druid item, Wolfshead Helm, has been nerfed in the latest WoW: Forever Beta Build.

Wolfshead Helm is a level 40 Druid item that can be crafted by Leatherworkers in World of Warcraft. In Classic WoW, this item's special effect grants bonus energy when you enter Cat Form. This causes Druids to gain bonus energy whenever they shift into Cat Form. This enabled "powershifting", where players would use a macro to swap out of form and back into Cat Form quickly to gain a burst of energy at the cost of mana. In WoW: Forever, the Wolfshead Helm now targets Shifting Power instead, which is a new ability that converts mana into Energy. This is more intuitive than powershifting, while still providing a similar effect: granting bonus energy at the cost of mana.

Wolfshead Helm
Item Level 45
Binds when equipped
HeadLeather
109 Armor
+10 Spirit
Durability 60 / 60
Classes: Druid
Requires Level 40
Equip: You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 5 Energy from activating Shifting Power.
Sell Price: 74 21


One of the problems from the original Classic was the power of Wolfshead Helm, especially when combined with the power of "powershifting". Because of these interactions, Wolfhead Helm was Best-in-slot for all of Classic, and even lasted into the majority of Burning Crusade. Many players have commented (such as on Reddit) that they don't want this item to be best-in-slot forever because that would be incredibly boring.

In the latest beta build, Wolfshead Helm has been nerfed and now only provides 5 bonus energy when using Shifting Power.
You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 205 Energy from activating Shifting Power.

title.en: Horde are Welcome in Dalaran After Completing the City of Dalaran Dungeon in WoW: Forever
title.es: La horda es bienvenida en Dalaran después de completar la mazmorra de la ciudad de Dalaran en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Horde are Welcome in Dalaran After Completing the City of Dalaran Dungeon in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: La horda es bienvenida en Dalaran después de completar la mazmorra de la ciudad de Dalaran en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
After getting access to the new dungeon City of Dalaran in the World of Warcraft: Forever beta, it was discovered that the previously believed Alliance-only city of Dalaran is now also available to Horde players upon completing the City of Dalaran dungeon and completing Heart of Disruption, the questline that awards players with Dalaran Sewer Key.

Upon completion, adventurers are asked to bring the Arcane Mote looted from Shade of the Archmage into the city through the quest Shrewd Negotiations.



Upon entering the city, the guards that were previously hostile are now neutral and will offer safe passage to any Horde player who has defeated the evil Archmage. After turning in the quest to Archmage Celindra, you can now roam around the city and explore its many interesting nooks and crannies.
Many of the citizens of Dalaran, while they may accept you in their midst, don't offer you any services. That being said, it's still a great way to stock up on supplies like arrows, food, and drinks, train Mage skills, and to change out any Hunter pet through the stables.

And, most importantly, Horde players can now enjoy the blissful activity of fishing for coins in the Dalaran fountain.


If you want more information on how to complete the Horde attunement questline and get access to Dalaran, the City of Dalaran Dungeon Guide is now live, along with complete quest tables, boss mechanics, and much more.

title.en: 16 Legacy Points Now Available for Testing on WoW: Forever Beta
title.es: 16 puntos heredados ahora disponibles para probar en WoW: Forever Beta

summary.en: 16 Legacy Points Now Available for Testing on WoW: Forever Beta...
summary.es: 16 puntos heredados ahora disponibles para probar en WoW: Forever Beta...

contentHtml:
In the latest WoW: Forever Beta build, all characters now have 16 Legacy Points to test the new Legacy Points talent tree.

Legacy Points GuideLegacy Points Calculator


New to WoW: Forever is an account-wide system called the Legacy System. As players complete certain objectives, talent points in the Legacy Tree will become available, and players can spend them on account-wide bonuses improving Professions, Adventuring, or Resourcefulness. Check out Wowhead's Legacy Calculator to see all the available options and share your favorite builds with your friends.

 


Players can unlock a maximum of 16 Legacy Points and Blizzard has unlocked all 16 Legacy Points on the WoW: Forever beta for players to test the new system! Log in and see what your favorite points are before the game goes live on November 4th.

title.en: Significant Nerfs to Crafted Decor Costs in Patch 12.1.5 - Lumber Costs Coming Down
title.es: Importantes nerfs a los costes de decoración artesanal en el parche 12.1.5 - Los costes de la madera están bajando

summary.en: Significant Nerfs to Crafted Decor Costs in Patch 12.1.5 - Lumber Costs Coming Down...
summary.es: Importantes nerfs a los costes de decoración artesanal en el parche 12.1.5 - Los costes de la madera están bajando...

contentHtml:
Blizzard is highlighting some significant nerfs to Crafted Decor costs in Patch 12.1.5, which includes reductions to lumber costs.

Decor Recipe Nerfs
Blizzard
View Original
We’ve been reviewing decor collection patterns, among other housing-related data, and based on that internal data (and player feedback as well!) we’re making a change in 12.1.5 that I’d like to highlight now that the patch release is right around the corner. All crafted decor from pre-Midnight professions will be getting their crafting cost reduced. 12.1 saw us do the same for Midnight profession recipes, and now we’re following it up with a significant reduction in decor crafting costs from all professions in all other expansions.

Some of these reductions are dramatic, some are merely significant. But this isn’t just a reduction in general reagent costs; lumber costs are coming down as well. We want players to craft and enjoy this decor, and we want players who have older professions leveled to see the benefit of those professions, and that will all be easier after the release of 12.1.5.

While some of the details may have changed, it looks like wowhead did a pretty good job collecting these changes a few weeks ago here: https://www.wowhead.com/news/over-200-decor-recipe-costs-nerfed-in-patch-12-1-5-382919

Happy crafting!

Chimes
